name: split-summary
program:
# Station report.                                                          #
# The three statistics are computed as ONE summary tuple, destructured,    #
# and each downstream grade depends on exactly one component of it.        #

let noise : Int -> Int =
  fun i -> int_mod(i * 7919 + 104729, 10007)
in
let readings : [(Int, Int, Int)] =
  init(400, fun i ->
    (int_mod(noise(i), 4),
     int_mod(noise(i + 1), 50) + 1,
     int_mod(noise(i + 2), 20) + 5))
in

let volume : (Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (_, v, _) -> v
in
let unit_cost : (Int, Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (_, _, c) -> c
in
let sum : [Int] -> Int =
  fun xs -> fold_left(xs, fun (acc, n) -> acc + n, 0)
in

# The summary. Each component is an aggregate over all 400 readings. #
let summary : (Int, Int, Int) =
  (sum(map(readings, volume)),
   sum(map(readings, unit_cost)),
   length(readings))
in
let (heavy_volume, peak_cost, heavy_count) = summary in

# Each grade is an expensive scan over every reading, seeded by one #
# component of the summary and nothing else.                        #
let grade : (Int, Int) -> Int =
  fun (seed, k) ->
    sum(map(readings, fun r ->
      int_mod(volume(r) * seed + unit_cost(r) * k, 9973)))
in

let volume_grade = grade(heavy_volume, 3) in
let cost_grade = grade(peak_cost, 5) in
let count_grade = grade(heavy_count, 7) in

(volume_grade, cost_grade, count_grade)

steps.label: fix component 0 (heavy volume)
actions: (Structural(Update Definition summary"(sum(map(filter(readings, fun r -> volume(r) > 30), volume)),\n sum(map(readings, unit_cost)),\n length(readings))"))

steps.label: fix component 1 (peak cost)
actions: (Structural(Update Definition summary"(sum(map(filter(readings, fun r -> volume(r) > 30), volume)),\n fold_left(map(readings, unit_cost), fun (acc, c) -> if acc > c then acc else c, 0),\n length(readings))"))

steps.label: fix component 2 (heavy count)
actions: (Structural(Update Definition summary"(sum(map(filter(readings, fun r -> volume(r) > 30), volume)),\n fold_left(map(readings, unit_cost), fun (acc, c) -> if acc > c then acc else c, 0),\n length(filter(readings, fun r -> volume(r) > 30)))"))

steps.label: retune component 1 (seed 5)
actions: (Structural(Update Definition summary"(sum(map(filter(readings, fun r -> volume(r) > 30), volume)),\n fold_left(map(readings, unit_cost), fun (acc, c) -> if acc > c then acc else c, 5),\n length(filter(readings, fun r -> volume(r) > 30)))"))
